reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are what get me, plus the money-back if I finish the box. At $24.99 it is cheap enough to try on impulse if a creator's video hits my sleep problem.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And I already have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I might not finish the box.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a creator I trust actually use it for a couple of weeks, or a clear reason why bisglycinate alone is enough.
